scope.firewall: Every feature, decision, label, future bar, match, parquet row and report row must be strictly before development_end_ms_exclusive; incomplete future windows are excluded.

provenance.preregistration_commit_sha: recorded from git history in formal artifacts
provenance.formal_code_sha: recorded from HEAD at formal execution in formal artifacts
provenance.protocol_sha256: recorded after this immutable file is committed

feature.bar_semantics: fully closed canonical 15m bars resampled from canonical BTCUSDT 1m bars
feature.regime: existing frozen classify_regime applied to latest fully closed 1h features available as of the 15m decision close
feature.center: arithmetic mean of the latest 20 fully closed 15m closes
feature.sigma: population standard deviation of those closes, ddof=0
feature.unavailable: fewer than 20 closed bars, sigma <= 0, missing data, or unavailable frozen 1h feature

entry_and_labels.entry_reference: OPEN of first canonical BTCUSDT 1m bar strictly after decision_close
entry_and_labels.adverse_boundary: entry_reference minus 1.0 frozen 1h ATR for LONG_FADE; plus 1.0 frozen 1h ATR for SHORT_FADE
entry_and_labels.ambiguous_primary_rule: count SAME_1M_BAR_AMBIGUOUS conservatively as center-first failure and include it in the complete-event denominator

episodes.definition: maximal consecutive available 15m decisions with the same extreme side
breaks_on: for RANGE population latest closed 1h regime no longer RANGE

h29.population: RANGE state and BOLL20_2Z extreme episode onsets
h29.support: 4h and 8h signed median return ATR > 0; 4h and 8h center-first rate > 0.50; signed-return weekly-bootstrap p05 >= -0.05; Early/Late signed medians >= -0.05; LONG_FADE/SHORT_FADE signed medians >= -0.05
h29.falsification: both 4h and 8h signed medians <= 0 OR both 4h and 8h center-first rates <= 0.50

h30.control_pool: episode onsets from the same exact BOLL20_2Z signal while market_state != RANGE

matching.selection: nearest by absolute time after satisfying frozen strata

h30.support: 4h and 8h matched signed-return median delta > 0; 4h and 8h center-first rate delta > 0; matched signed-return bootstrap p05 >= -0.05
h30.falsification: both 4h and 8h signed-return deltas <= 0 OR both 4h and 8h center-first deltas <= 0
